source: Owner direct chat after playing the MSQ-103 delivery
owner_message_original: Поиграл. Пока слабо, противник очень медленно решение генерирует, да он бегает, да ищет потом, но выглядит парвда как маникен, а не как реальный противник. Я предлагаю начать вводить, назовем так руководитель отряда, я не знаю может уже есть термин у этого. То есть все должно сильно меняться, от ситуации на поле боя, если противник один остался и потерял гг из виду, то наиболее уместо не ходить искать по среди зала как дибил, что бы тебе сзади зашли, а пойти и занять такую позицию где тебе не зайдут в спину. Позже я думаю мы введем некие элемент как мину ловушки,  смокове гранаты(что бы рашить когда надо и что бы скрыться) и что бы проитивник всем этим активно пользовался прям по ходу боя.
owner_message_english_translation: I played. It is still weak: the enemy makes decisions very slowly. It runs and then searches, but looks like a mannequin rather than a real opponent. I propose starting to introduce what we could call a squad leader; perhaps there is already a term for it. Behavior should change strongly with the battlefield situation. If an enemy is the last one left and loses sight of the protagonist, it should take a position where it cannot be approached from behind rather than foolishly searching in the middle of the hall. Later I think we will introduce mines/traps and smoke grenades for rushing when appropriate and escaping, and enemies should actively use these during combat.
direction: Begin developing situational tactical coordination. Prioritize responsiveness and a defensible lost-contact policy for an isolated or last remaining enemy. Persistent alert/search may include protected observation and control of approaches instead of continuous exposed movement.
owner_play_feedback: Owner observed running and continued searching, but considers overall combat behavior weak. This is not owner acceptance of combat feel or all pending runtime criteria.
future_scope: Mines/traps and smoke for advance/withdrawal are later mechanics. Prepare their role in tactical decisions without representing them as implemented or requested for immediate production.
controller_response: Audit current source and record a concrete tactical design refinement. Ask which nearest delivery the owner prefers: one tactically capable enemy first or immediate two/three-member cooperation. The default recommendation is the former.
interpretation_boundary: The owner supplies the tactical direction. Detailed architecture, package slicing, reaction tuning and population are controller proposals unless separately selected. This record does not assert a new implementation run, alter live task dependencies or waive independent technical review.
verification: Retain the existing owner-only gameplay-testing boundary. Source observations of timers are not runtime measurements of the owner's session.
